title: alpha-Hederin inhibits the platelet activating factor-induced metastasis of HCC cells through disruption of PAF/PTAFR axis cascaded STAT3/MMP-2 expression.
authors: Cao, Linna; Zhang, Yiwei; Mi, Jinxia; Shi, Zhanhao; Fang, Zhaoqin; Jia, Dongwei; Pan, Zhiqiang; Peng, Peike
one_liner_zh: 该文研究alpha-Hederin抑制PAF诱导的肝癌转移，涉及分子对接预测靶点，但核心是药物-蛋白互作与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Metastasis remains a crucial obstacle to the clinical treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Investigating the potential anti-tumor compounds from medicinal herb against HCC metastasis is of particular interest. As a triterpenoid saponin, alpha-Hederin has been reported to exhibit cytotoxicity for diverse cancer cell lines by inducing mitochondrial related apoptosis or autophagic cell death. Nevertheless, little is known about the inhibitory effect of alpha-Hederin on the metastasis of HCC and its underlying mechanisms. Here, we integrated well-established target prediction webtool and molecular docking methods to predict the potential targets for alpha-Hederin, and finally focused on PTAFR, the receptor for platelet-activating factor (PAF). Activation of PAF/PTAFR pathways has been reported to be contribution to the initiation and progression of cancer. We showed for the first time that non-cytotoxic concentration of alpha-Hederin inhibited cell migration and invasion induced by PAF in HCC cells, as well as lung metastasis in vivo. Moreover, we demonstrated alpha-Hederin reduced the PAF-induced matrix metalloproteinase-2 expression through inhibiting the activation of STAT3 in PAF stimulated HCC cells. These findings suggest that alpha-Hederin functions as a prospective inhibitor of PTAFR and may be utilized as an optional candidate for treatment of HCC.
abstract_zh: 转移仍是肝细胞癌（HCC）临床治疗中的关键障碍。研究药用植物中潜在的抗肿瘤化合物对抗HCC转移具有特别意义。作为一种三萜皂苷，α-常春藤素（alpha-Hederin）已被报道通过诱导线粒体相关凋亡或自噬性细胞死亡，对多种癌细胞系表现出细胞毒性。然而，关于α-常春藤素对HCC转移的抑制作用及其潜在机制知之甚少。在此，我们整合了成熟的目标预测网络工具和分子对接方法，以预测α-常春藤素的潜在靶点，并最终聚焦于血小板活化因子（PAF）受体PTAFR。据报道，PAF/PTAFR通路的激活有助于癌症的发生和进展。我们首次证明，非细胞毒性浓度的α-常春藤素抑制了HCC细胞中PAF诱导的细胞迁移和侵袭，以及体内肺转移。此外，我们证明α-常春藤素通过抑制PAF刺激的HCC细胞中STAT3的激活，降低了PAF诱导的基质金属蛋白酶-2表达。这些发现表明，α-常春藤素作为PTAFR的潜在抑制剂，可能被用作治疗HCC的备选候选药物。
